project.topic: Addis Ababa — hills, history, and daily heritage
project.target_audience: Young adults curious about urban African heritage
project.visual_style: Cinematic documentary, golden hour, bustling city and green hills, respectful tone
project.creative_direction: Separate documented history from artistic reconstruction; no real people's likeness without consent.
project.music_prompt: Instrumental Ethiopian jazz and krar undertones, urban and warm, meditative, 80 seconds, no vocals

metadata.historical_notes: Addis Ababa founded as capital in late 19th century; seat of AU; diverse communities and languages.
metadata.creative_notes: Crowd scenes and some interiors are stylized reconstructions, not news footage.

loc_addis_hills.description: Panoramic view of Addis Ababa from Entoto hills, city spread in valley, documentary wide shot

char_narrator.description: Young Ethiopian heritage storyteller, modest modern dress, warm expression, not a celebrity likeness

shots.narration_text: Addis Ababa rises between green hills—a capital where many Ethiopian stories meet.
